env_vars.name: DATABASE_URL
env_vars.description: Postgres connection string (from Supabase dashboard > Settings > Database)

env_vars.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
env_vars.description: Service role key (for edge functions and API calls)

execute_sql.guidance: Add LIMIT N to large queries to avoid context overflow

apply_migration.guidance: Pass the full SQL migration as a string

notes: Multi-statement transactions require a single psql -f script.sql invocation. Edge function management (list, deploy) requires the Supabase CLI or API calls and is not covered by this mapping.
